what: The prompt mandates registering tag_gamma_dtype/tag_gamma_layout in INPUT_TAGGERS, but cartesian() does not iterate an axis that has a registered tagger and a tagger only sees the shape, so every cartesian gamma cell is tagged none and skipped by INVALID {gamma_mode: gamma, gamma_dtype: none}: 1680/1680 gamma cells were silently never run (supported_pass 177 instead of 737), with the verifier CLI showing clean
suggest: Change the prompt to: keep the none-sentinel functions for validate()/classification but do NOT register gamma_dtype/gamma_layout in INPUT_TAGGERS (only shape-derived axes go there); document the tagger-wins rule in REGISTRY_MODEL.md next to the canonicalization rule; optionally have verify_supported warn when a TARGET axis is shadowed by a tagger
